title: Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards Line Review Decision Table: Credit Line Change Recency Share
content:
**Rule.** On a credit line review of a Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards account, the recency share is counted on the full calendar months since the last credit line change date (or since the opened date when the line has never changed): when fewer than 12 have passed, it is 0.1 plus 0.05 for each of those full months; when at least 12 but fewer than 24 have passed, it is 0.8; when 24 or more have passed, it is 1.0. The line-review increase percentage is multiplied by the recency share before it is applied to the current credit line.

The dates read are the last credit line change date and the opened date on the account record.

## Decision table

| Full calendar months since the last change (or the opening) | Recency share |
|---|---|
| fewer than 12 | 0.1 plus 0.05 for each full month |
| at least 12 and fewer than 24 | 0.8 |
| 24 or more | 1.0 |

## The sliding part in figures

| Full months | Recency share |
|---|---|
| 0 | 0.1 |
| 1 | 0.15 |
| 6 | 0.1 plus 0.30: 0.4 |
| 11 | 0.1 plus 0.55: 0.65 |
| 12 | 0.8 |
| 23 | 0.8 |
| 24 | 1.0 |

## Cases (hypothetical dates; review held on 20 May)

| Last credit line change | Opened date | Full months passed | Share |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10 August of the previous year | eight years earlier | 9 | 0.1 plus 0.45: 0.55 |
| 10 March of the previous year | eight years earlier | 14 | 0.8 |
| never changed | 10 February three years earlier | 39 | 1.0 |

A line-review increase percentage of 30 multiplied by a recency share of 0.55 is 16.5.
